# 2. GENERIC CHAPTER 6 HELPERS

ch6_fixed_year_metric <- function(
    df,
    column,
    earlier_year,
    latest_year,
    section_id,
    section,
    measure,
    stat_id,
    value_type,
    change_type,
    emphasis = FALSE
) {
  if (!all(c("Year", column) %in% names(df))) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  earlier <- df %>%
    filter(
      .data$Year == .env$earlier_year
    )

  latest <- df %>%
    filter(
      .data$Year == .env$latest_year
    )

  if (
    nrow(earlier) != 1L ||
    nrow(latest) != 1L
  ) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  metric_values(
    stat_id = stat_id,
    section_id = section_id,
    section = section,
    measure = measure,
    first_value = earlier[[column]][[1]],
    first_label = earlier_year,
    last_value = latest[[column]][[1]],
    last_label = latest_year,
    value_type = value_type,
    change_type = change_type,
    emphasis = emphasis
  )
}


ch6_series_metric <- function(
    df,
    column,
    section_id,
    section,
    measure,
    stat_id,
    value_type,
    change_type,
    emphasis = FALSE
) {
  metric_series(
    stat_id = stat_id,
    section_id = section_id,
    section = section,
    measure = measure,
    df = df,
    column = column,
    value_type = value_type,
    change_type = change_type,
    emphasis = emphasis
  )
}


ch6_sum_series <- function(
    df,
    columns
) {
  row_sum_data(
    df,
    columns
  ) %>%
    rename(
      Total = .data$Value
    )
}


ch6_peak_endpoint <- function(
    series
) {
  row <- series %>%
    slice_max(
      order_by = .data$Value,
      n = 1,
      with_ties = FALSE
    )

  list(
    value = row$Value[[1]],
    year = row$Year[[1]],
    label = calendar_year_label(
      row$Year[[1]]
    )
  )
}


ch6_first_endpoint <- function(
    series
) {
  row <- series %>%
    slice_head(n = 1)

  list(
    value = row$Value[[1]],
    year = row$Year[[1]],
    label = calendar_year_label(
      row$Year[[1]]
    )
  )
}


ch6_last_endpoint <- function(
    series
) {
  row <- series %>%
    slice_tail(n = 1)

  list(
    value = row$Value[[1]],
    year = row$Year[[1]],
    label = calendar_year_label(
      row$Year[[1]]
    )
  )
}


ch6_largest_decline <- function(
    df,
    column
) {
  series <- series_data(
    df,
    column
  )

  if (nrow(series) < 2L) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  candidates <- purrr::map_dfr(
    2:nrow(series),
    function(i) {
      prior <- series[
        1:(i - 1),
        ,
        drop = FALSE
      ]

      peak <- prior %>%
        slice_max(
          order_by = .data$Value,
          n = 1,
          with_ties = FALSE
        )

      tibble(
        peak_year = peak$Year[[1]],
        peak_value = peak$Value[[1]],
        trough_year = series$Year[[i]],
        trough_value = series$Value[[i]],
        decline = peak$Value[[1]] -
          series$Value[[i]]
      )
    }
  )

  best <- candidates %>%
    slice_max(
      order_by = .data$decline,
      n = 1,
      with_ties = FALSE
    )

  list(
    peak = list(
      year = best$peak_year[[1]],
      label = calendar_year_label(
        best$peak_year[[1]]
      ),
      value = best$peak_value[[1]]
    ),
    trough = list(
      year = best$trough_year[[1]],
      label = calendar_year_label(
        best$trough_year[[1]]
      ),
      value = best$trough_value[[1]]
    )
  )
}

ch6_h1b_denial_series <- function(
    approved_df,
    denied_df
) {
  approved <- series_data(
    approved_df,
    "New Approved"
  ) %>%
    rename(
      Approved = .data$Value
    )

  denied <- series_data(
    denied_df,
    "New Denials"
  ) %>%
    rename(
      Denied = .data$Value
    )

  inner_join(
    approved,
    denied,
    by = "Year"
  ) %>%
    transmute(
      Year = .data$Year,
      Value = .data$Denied /
        (
          .data$Approved +
            .data$Denied
        )
    ) %>%
    filter(
      is.finite(.data$Value)
    ) %>%
    arrange(
      .data$Year
    )
}

# 7. PERMANENT-RESIDENCE BOTTLENECK — FIGURE 6.06 + TABLES 6.04–6.05
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

ch6_perm_expired_series <- function(
    country
) {
  tab604 %>%
    filter(
      normalize_label(.data$Country) ==
        normalize_label(.env$country),
      normalize_label(.data$Status) %in%
        c(
          normalize_label("Certified"),
          normalize_label("Certified-Expired")
        )
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      StatusClean = dplyr::case_when(
        normalize_label(.data$Status) ==
          normalize_label("Certified") ~
          "Used",

        normalize_label(.data$Status) ==
          normalize_label("Certified-Expired") ~
          "Expired",

        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      )
    ) %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(.data$StatusClean)
    ) %>%
    group_by(
      .data$Year,
      .data$StatusClean
    ) %>%
    summarise(
      Count = sum(
        .data$Count,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider(
      names_from = .data$StatusClean,
      values_from = .data$Count,
      values_fill = 0
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      Value = .data$Expired /
        (
          .data$Used +
            .data$Expired
        )
    ) %>%
    filter(
      is.finite(.data$Value)
    ) %>%
    arrange(
      .data$Year
    )
}


ch6_perm_expired_metric <- function(
    country,
    stat_id,
    emphasis = FALSE
) {
  series <- ch6_perm_expired_series(
    country
  )

  # Match the published Table 6.04 comparison window.
  first <- series %>%
    filter(
      .data$Year == 2008L
    )

  last <- series %>%
    filter(
      .data$Year == 2024L
    )

  if (
    nrow(first) != 1L ||
    nrow(last) != 1L
  ) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  metric_values(
    stat_id = stat_id,
    section_id = "permanence",
    section = "Permanent-residence bottleneck",
    measure = paste0(
      country,
      ": PERM certifications expiring unused"
    ),
    first_value = first$Value[[1]],
    first_label = 2008L,
    last_value = last$Value[[1]],
    last_label = 2024L,
    value_type = "share",
    change_type = "pp_share",
    emphasis = emphasis
  )
}

ch6_wait_endpoint <- function(
    df,
    category,
    year
) {
  row <- df %>%
    filter(
      .data$Year == .env$year
    )

  if (nrow(row) != 1L) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  value <- row[[category]][[1]]

  if (!is.finite(value)) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  list(
    year = year,
    value = value
  )
}


ch6_wait_label <- function(
    months
) {
  months <- round(months)

  if (!is.finite(months)) {
    return("—")
  }

  if (months == 0L) {
    return("0 mo")
  }

  years <- months %/% 12
  remainder <- months %% 12

  if (years == 0L) {
    return(
      paste0(
        remainder,
        " mo"
      )
    )
  }

  if (remainder == 0L) {
    return(
      paste0(
        years,
        "y"
      )
    )
  }

  paste0(
    years,
    "y ",
    remainder,
    "m"
  )
}


ch6_wait_change_label <- function(
    first_months,
    last_months
) {
  difference <- round(
    last_months -
      first_months
  )

  if (!is.finite(difference)) {
    return("—")
  }

  sign <- if (difference > 0) {
    "+"
  } else if (difference < 0) {
    "-"
  } else {
    ""
  }

  paste0(
    sign,
    ch6_wait_label(
      abs(difference)
    )
  )
}


ch6_wait_metric <- function(
    df,
    geography,
    category,
    stat_id,
    emphasis = FALSE
) {
  # Match the displayed Table 6.05: 2005 → 2025.
  first <- ch6_wait_endpoint(
    df,
    category,
    2005L
  )

  last <- ch6_wait_endpoint(
    df,
    category,
    2025L
  )

  if (
    is.null(first) ||
    is.null(last)
  ) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  metric_text(
    stat_id = stat_id,
    section_id = "permanence",
    section = "Permanent-residence bottleneck",
    measure = paste0(
      geography,
      " ",
      category,
      " green-card wait"
    ),
    earlier = paste0(
      ch6_wait_label(
        first$value
      ),
      " (2005)"
    ),
    latest = paste0(
      ch6_wait_label(
        last$value
      ),
      " (2025)"
    ),
    change = ch6_wait_change_label(
      first$value,
      last$value
    ),
    emphasis = emphasis
  )
}

ch6_fig608_value <- function(
    country
) {
  value <- fig608 %>%
    filter(
      normalize_label(.data$Country) ==
        normalize_label(.env$country)
    ) %>%
    pull(
      .data$`Gap with the native-born`
    )

  if (
    length(value) != 1L ||
    !is.finite(value[[1]])
  ) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }

  value[[1]]
}


ch6_us_work_gap <- ch6_fig608_value(
  "United States"
)

ch6_oecd_work_gap <- ch6_fig608_value(
  "OECD average"
)


ch6_workforce_benchmark <- if (
  is.finite(ch6_us_work_gap) &&
  is.finite(ch6_oecd_work_gap)
) {
  metric_text(
    stat_id = "workforce_gap_us_vs_oecd",
    section_id = "loss",
    section = "Other signals and talent loss",
    measure = "Immigrant employment gap relative to native-born",
    earlier = paste0(
      "OECD: ",
      sprintf(
        "%+.1f pp (2025)",
        ch6_oecd_work_gap
      )
    ),
    latest = paste0(
      "US: ",
      sprintf(
        "%+.1f pp (2025)",
        ch6_us_work_gap
      )
    ),
    change = sprintf(
      "%+.1f pp",
      ch6_us_work_gap -
        ch6_oecd_work_gap
    ),
    emphasis = TRUE
  )
} else {
  NULL
}


ch6_loss_by_field <- fig609 %>%
  mutate(
    retained = round(
      .data$recipients *
        .data$stay_rate_10yr
    ),
    lost = .data$recipients -
      .data$retained,
    lost_share = 1 -
      .data$stay_rate_10yr
  )


ch6_total_recipients <- sum(
  ch6_loss_by_field$recipients,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

ch6_total_retained <- sum(
  ch6_loss_by_field$retained,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

ch6_total_lost <- sum(
  ch6_loss_by_field$lost,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

ch6_total_lost_share <- if (
  ch6_total_recipients > 0
) {
  ch6_total_lost /
    ch6_total_recipients
} else {
  NA_real_
}


ch6_loss_metric <- function(
    field,
    stat_id,
    emphasis = FALSE
) {
  row <- ch6_loss_by_field %>%
    filter(
      normalize_label(.data$field) ==
        normalize_label(.env$field)
    )

  if (nrow(row) != 1L) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  metric_text(
    stat_id = stat_id,
    section_id = "loss",
    section = "Other signals and talent loss",
    measure = paste0(
      field,
      ": US-trained international PhDs after ten years"
    ),
    earlier = paste0(
      scales::comma(
        row$recipients[[1]],
        accuracy = 1
      ),
      " trained (2012–14)"
    ),
    latest = paste0(
      scales::comma(
        row$retained[[1]],
        accuracy = 1
      ),
      " retained"
    ),
    change = paste0(
      "-",
      scales::comma(
        row$lost[[1]],
        accuracy = 1
      ),
      " (",
      scales::percent(
        row$lost_share[[1]],
        accuracy = 1
      ),
      ")"
    ),
    emphasis = emphasis
  )
}


ch6_total_loss_metric <- metric_text(
  stat_id = "trained_total",
  section_id = "loss",
  section = "Other signals and talent loss",
  measure = "US-trained international STEM PhDs after ten years",
  earlier = paste0(
    scales::comma(
      ch6_total_recipients,
      accuracy = 1
    ),
    " trained (2012–14)"
  ),
  latest = paste0(
    scales::comma(
      ch6_total_retained,
      accuracy = 1
    ),
    " retained"
  ),
  change = paste0(
    "-",
    scales::comma(
      ch6_total_lost,
      accuracy = 1
    ),
    " (",
    scales::percent(
      ch6_total_lost_share,
      accuracy = 1
    ),
    ")"
  ),
  emphasis = TRUE
)

# 9. CODE THE FULL CURRENT CHAPTER 6 STATISTIC SET

  filter(

  mutate(

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 11. BUILD PAGES
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

build_ch6_page <- function(
    page_data,
    page_number,
    total_pages,
    is_last_page
) {

  final_notes <- if (
    is_last_page
  ) {
    c(
      paste0(
        "**Note:** Longitudinal rows compare the stated first and latest ",
        "observations unless otherwise noted. Table 6.03 career-path rows ",
        "compare 1994 with 2024. Table 6.04 PERM-expiration rows compare ",
        "2008 with 2024. Green-card wait rows compare 2005 with 2025 to match ",
        "the published Table 6.05. Figure 6.09 uses the 2012–14 doctorate ",
        "cohorts and estimates retention from published ten-year stay rates. ",
        "Arrow colors indicate numeric direction only, not whether the authors ",
        "consider the change positive or negative."
      ),

      paste0(
        "**Source:** Current report data underlying Figures 6.01–6.09 and ",
        "Tables 6.01–6.05. See the cited figures and tables for full source ",
        "information."
      )
    )
  } else {
    character()
  }

  build_infographic_table(
    data = page_data,
    id = paste0(
      "infographic_ch6_by_the_numbers_page_",
      sprintf(
        "%02d",
        page_number
      )
    ),
    chapter_number = 6,
    title = "THE RETENTION GAP: BY THE NUMBERS",
    subtitle = "Why America is losing talent that wants to stay",
    column_labels = c(
      Earlier = "Earlier or<br>baseline",
      Latest  = "Latest or<br>outcome",
      Change  = "Change"
    ),
    notes = final_notes,
    layout = INFOGRAPHIC_FIXED_LAYOUT,
    row_padding_px = INFOGRAPHIC_FIXED_LAYOUT$row_padding_px,
    nowrap_values = TRUE
  )
}


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 12. EXPORT THROUGH THE GLOBAL HEADER-AWARE PAGINATION RULE
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

ch6_exports <- export_paginated_infographic(
  data = ch6_selected,
  build_page = build_ch6_page,
  name = "infographic_ch6_by_the_numbers"
)


knitr::include_graphics(
  vapply(
    ch6_exports,
    `[[`,
    character(1),
    "png_path"
  )
)
